volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: Latch: freeze Model/Attack/Release/Curve/Sensitivity on rising Retrigger. Free: knobs always live. Retrigger never resets the level; unconnected Retrigger = Free.

attack.tooltip: Rise time constant toward a brighter Light target. 0 = instant.

release.tooltip: Fall time constant toward a dimmer Light target (photoconductive lag).

curve.tooltip: Gamma after the one-pole. 1 = linear; >1 digs in; <1 lifts the tail.

partials.tooltip: Partial count cap. Fractional values fade the top partial in (e.g. 3.5 = three partials plus the fourth at half level), so sweeps are smooth.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: Side to side. Trimorph: trisaw peak position (0.5 = triangle, toward 0.01 / 0.99 = saw / ramp). Square (PWM): pulse width. Band-limited at every setting (moves the offset DSF kernel).

blend.tooltip: SquSaw only: saw (0) to square (1), a crossfade of two band-limited waves from the same kernel. Other waveforms ignore it.

bright.tooltip: Harmonic tilt (DSF geometric rolloff): 0 = sine, 1 = the full bright wave. Band-limited at every setting. Nonlinear slider: more sensitivity near 0 (where most of the useful range is).

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

pulseStart.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes high. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseEnd.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes low. Quantized to whole samples.

frequency.tooltip: Hz. Self-osc pitch is referenced at Resonance 0.8. MOD adds Hz.

dither.tooltip: On mixes a noise band highpassed at Frequency and lowpassed at 4×Frequency into the inner oscillator. Left and Right each have their own stream. Start / Full / Amount set the mix.

start.tooltip: Frequency where the noise-band mix begins. Below this the inner oscillator stays clean.

full.tooltip: Frequency where the noise-band mix reaches Amount. Log ramp between Start and Full.

amount.tooltip: Noise-band mix at Full. 0 = inner oscillator only. 1 = replace with the ƒ…4ƒ band.

seed.tooltip: Chaos + dither noise seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.
